description: Without sign-in, saves a private draft listing on Neeed Directory and returns a claim link: nothing is published or charged until the maker opens it, signs in and submits. Signed in with permission to edit listings, submits the listing to the maker's account: Neeed's automatic check publishes it or holds it for review, and Premium returns a Stripe Checkout link the maker pays in the browser.
